candidates.title: available self-mobility
candidates.definition: A mover's capacity to change its own position that is presently available for exercise.

candidates.title: latent self-mobility
candidates.definition: A mover's capacity to change its own position that exists without being presently available for exercise.

candidates.title: available physical work capacity
candidates.definition: A material bearer's capacity to supply energy for physical change that is presently available for exercise.

candidates.title: latent physical work capacity
candidates.definition: A material bearer's capacity to supply energy for physical change that exists without being presently available for exercise.

candidates.title: available attentional capacity
candidates.definition: A cognizer's capacity to allocate cognitive processing selectively that is presently available for exercise.

candidates.title: latent attentional capacity
candidates.definition: A cognizer's capacity to allocate cognitive processing selectively that exists without being presently available for exercise.

candidates.title: completed source expression
candidates.definition: Completion of an act by which a source endpoint makes a communicative expression available to an exchange context.

candidates.title: completed shared distribution
candidates.definition: Completion of an act by which a communicative expression is made available across a shared channel to multiple participant endpoints.

candidates.title: available communicative participation capacity
candidates.definition: A communicative capacity of an endpoint that is presently available for exercise in an exchange.

candidates.title: latent communicative participation capacity
candidates.definition: A communicative capacity of an endpoint that exists without being presently available for exercise.

candidates.title: available internal reconfiguration capacity
candidates.definition: A capacity of a reference structure to reassign its own constituents among its internal positions that is presently available for exercise while preserving that structure as the reference whole.

candidates.title: latent internal reconfiguration capacity
candidates.definition: A capacity of a reference structure to reassign its own constituents among its internal positions that exists without being presently available for exercise while preserving that structure as the reference whole.

senses.example: The tea is available to Nora.
The tea is available for sale.
The tool is available for use.

conclusions: Existing capacity roots remain domain-specific; their shared available wording is not a general resource-availability invariant.
Runtime 1 cannot by itself encode available-to-whom, for-what or under-which-conditions.
No new family is justified by this inventory; evaluate scoped opportunity/access composition before a new convention.
Bare availability remains unresolved rather than silently selecting a sense.
next_dependencies: explicit activity content and its participant binding
scope-aware possibility distinct from normative permission
limitations: Authored distinctions, not independent semantic review.
Does not prove that no existing compound composition can express a specific selected reading.
No dictionary, parser, music code or source approval changes.
